g.text: Doubly linked removal: reconnect each neighbor before clearing the target
A separate example starts from 10 <-> 20 <-> 30. Node 20 stays visible while links change.
1. Set 10.next = 30; the backward link still points to 20
3. Clear 20.prev and 20.next; head stays 10 and tail stays 30
The remaining list is 10 <-> 30. Removing an endpoint also changes head or tail.
